cli.description: Everything around Breath of the Wild on Cemu: mods, profiles, saves, co-op.
cli.epilog:
Without a command, botw opens a menu. English by default; 'botw lang fr' switches.
Examples:  botw deploy sur          botw catalog sur --deploy
          botw mods search wind    botw newgame

coop.cemu_open: Cemu is open: close it, it rewrites settings.xml on exit.
coop.enable_hint: Turn it on with: botw coop enable

coop.radmin.firewall: Windows Firewall blocks private networks by default; allow Cemu on private networks.
coop.radmin.missing: Radmin VPN not detected on this machine.
coop.radmin.not_connected: Radmin VPN is installed but not connected.
coop.radmin.step1: Install Radmin VPN on both PCs and create a network with the same name.
coop.radmin.step2: Both players must be on that network; check the address shown by 'botw coop radmin'.
coop.radmin.step3: Same game version, same mods, same profile on both machines ('botw profile show').
coop.radmin.step4: Player 2 starts Cemu, opens the game, presses + on his controller.
coop.radmin.step5: Player 1 does the same; BOTW finds the session on the local network.
coop.radmin.title: Two players over the network
